# `tfctl auth status`

The `tfctl auth status` command displays information about the current authentication token.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth status [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl auth status` command displays information about the currently active profile's account and token, including when the token expires if that information is available.

The command prints out the hostname, username, and token expiration time (if available) for the active profile.

If you are not authenticated or the token is invalid, the command prints an error message.

## Available options

The `tfctl auth status` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Exit codes

- `0`: Successfully authenticated
- `6`: Not authenticated or token is invalid

## Examples

The following example demonstrates how to check authentication status with HCP Terraform.

### Show authentication status

The following example displays information about the current authentication token.

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth status
```
